name: note-note-note
features: Pad shows a picture snapped into colored squares with DMC color and square code toggles.
Move, select, out and fit tools work, with rotate, size and reset.
Brush and box select squares, and make one note groups them into a note.
Notes search, undo after delete, and add a mind map here.
Data saves in the browser database, and export backup, import backup and erase everything work.
